name: Dual mixed refrigerant liquefaction
principle: Two mixed refrigerant cycles replace the propane-plus-mixed-refrigerant arrangement. A precooling mixed refrigerant cools the gas in spiral-wound precoolers, and a second mixed refrigerant of nitrogen, methane, ethane, propane and some butane liquefies the gas over about -40 °C to -150 °C in the main cryogenic heat exchanger. Adjusting the two compositions lets the plant follow seasonal ambient temperature.

performance.metric: liquefaction temperature range of the MR cycle

source.note: Gas Processing & LNG, Optimal control of mixed refrigerant composition at Sakhalin LNG plant, 1 October 2018
